messages:
alex: Kicking off release/2026-03-21 16:00 UTC deploy. Preflight SLO set to run in 4m. Keep eyes on kv-cache and embed routes.
deploy-bot: Rollout queued: v2026-03-21 -> instances 120->140. Strategy: canary 5%, ramp 50%, full. Release doc: https://deploys.redwood/2026-03-21
slo-bot: Preflight snapshot: /generate p95=45ms baseline=40ms, /embed p99=60ms baseline=55ms, 5xx baseline=0.04%
carla: saw a kv-cache tail p99 blip last night in eu-west. @slo-bot include kv-cache tail p95/p99 on the live checks pls.
slo-bot: kv-cache tail preflight: p95=20ms baseline=18ms, p99=72ms baseline=60ms (+20%).
ryan: that aligns with the embed blip. Any infra changes this morning?
maya: micro-change to quantize-worker deployed earlier on dedicated pools. Not related to model data.
alex: plan: start canary at 5% but enable a 10m snooze gating window. Hard gates: p99 > 2x baseline OR 5xx > 0.5% => pause. Prepare pin command for embeds.
carla: pin ready: /deploy pin v2026-03-20 --reason "canary p99 spike"
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 16:05 UTC. Traffic allocated to canary = 5% (6 nodes).
slo-bot: Live canary metrics (16:07): /embed p99=92ms (1.67x baseline), 5xx=0.11%, kv-cache p99=88ms (+46%). monitoring_window=2m
ryan: keep watching. not yet at hard gate.
alex: if p99 crosses 2x baseline (110ms) or 5xx > 0.5% for sustained 1m then we pause and rollback canary. @carla @maya stand by to pin and rollback worker.
carla: stood by. pin command in clipboard.
maya: ready to roll quantize-worker back on dedicated pools if needed.
slo-bot: Alert (16:12): /embed p99=138ms (2.5x baseline) over 1m. 5xx=0.22%. kv-cache p99=130ms
deploy-bot: SLO gate triggered -> pausing canary and initiating rollback at 16:12 UTC.
alex: execute pin and rollback. Route pinging now for /embed to v2026-03-20.
carla: ran `/deploy pin v2026-03-20 --reason "canary p99 spike"` — routing pinned for /embed.
ryan: I'm triggering rollback of quantize-worker on dedicated pools (eu-west-2, us-east-1).
maya: rollback complete on eu-west-2, us-east-1 (16:15).
slo-bot: Post-rollback snapshot (16:17): /embed p99=56ms, 5xx=0.03%, kv-cache p99=58ms — metrics back within baseline.
alex: nice. I'll mark the release as paused and update release notes. We'll reopen when root cause of kv-cache tail spike is identified.
carla: added to release notes: canary paused and /embed pinned due to kv-cache tail p99 regression correlated with quantize-worker change.
alex: scheduling follow-up bug with infra and runtime teams to dig into quantize-worker interactions with KV cache. Closing thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
